task.id: unique run identifier; retry gets a new id
task.question: original normalized question without /help prefix
task.quality: NOT_ASSESSED until an independent content review
task.sources: relative path, start/end lines, source hash, chunk id, label, excerpt
task.plan: steps with id, depends_on, check and execution status

schedules.next_run: After previous completion; no overlapping or catch-up burst
schedules.restart: Interrupted trigger is paused for owner review
